summary: Testing scope: AI Cost-Control & Supplier Performance (backend + frontend smoke). Backend: 19/19 pytest cases PASSED (my-budget/route/deterministic-mode/premium-downgrade/premium-director/spend-monthly/supplier-performance + 3 regression). Frontend smoke: 10/10 checks passed on mobile viewport 390x844 — director wallet chip shows 'unlimited', all 4 tier chips (Deterministic, Auto, GPT-4o-mini, Sonnet 4.5) render for director and Sonnet is clickable; PM sees '₹199.90 left of ₹200' wallet chip and Sonnet chip is greyed out with 'Director only' label; /ai-admin loads for director with both tabs populated and grand total ₹ shown; /more shows the AI Spend & Supplier Performance button only for director/admin; PM hitting /ai-admin directly sees the 'Admin or Director role required' guard.
critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: /app/backend/routers/llm.py:245 `_enforce_tier_and_budget` performs the tier-downgrade *before* the budget check, so a non-director requesting `premium` will hit the ₹200 budget guard (correct) rather than being told premium is disallowed first; the current behavior is what the spec wanted (silent downgrade + budget applied to cheap tier).

Non-blocking: /app/backend/routers/llm.py:960 supplier-performance aggregates PO totals but treats missing `total` as 0.0 — fine for now, but if PO schema changes to nest totals inside `summary`, `total_ordered_value_inr` will silently return 0.
seed_data_creation: None — all endpoints tested against the existing dev seed. Deterministic + premium director + PM downgrade calls each persist a suggestion row in llm_suggestions (kind=purchase_analysis) which populates the admin spend rollup used by /ai-admin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is the correct env key (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Regression endpoints for MRF/PO are singular: GET /api/mrf and GET /api/po (NOT /api/mrfs or /api/pos). Dev-login: POST /api/auth/dev-login with body {email, role, name}; token is returned as `session_token` and must be sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. For the frontend smoke: /login has demo buttons with testID pattern `demo-<role>-btn` and the AI admin screen exposes `ai-admin-tab-spend` + `ai-admin-tab-suppliers`. Tier chips on assistant/negotiate use `aipm-tier-{deterministic|auto|cheap|premium}` testIDs.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 8 spec test buckets green: (1) /my-budget director unlimited vs pm ₹200; (2) /route model_labels dict + premium_allowed; (3) deterministic mode returns tier='deterministic', model='deterministic', output_parsed._engine='deterministic', decision ∈ {ok_current, negotiate_more, reject_and_retender, issue_at_target}, cost.cost_inr=0.0 for PM without any 402; (4) PM premium request → HTTP 200 with tier downgraded to 'cheap', model='gpt-4o-mini', routing.downgraded=true, downgrade_reason mentions Director; (5) Director premium → HTTP 200 with tier='premium', model='claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929'; (6) /admin/spend-monthly returns all 7 required keys, by_user rows carry limit_inr/remaining_inr/role, premium_allowed_roles=['director'], PM gets 403; (7) /admin/supplier-performance returns list with total_orders/completed_orders/on_time_pct/avg_delay_days/last_order_date for director/admin/gm/purchase, site_engineer gets 403; (8) regression: /api/mrf, /api/po, /api/vendors all return 200 lists.
